Class CommandHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.controller.commandHandlers.CommandHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
AssigningCrewCmdHandler, CorrectingShipCmdHandler, LobbyCmdHandler, PickingCardsCmdHandler, ShipBuildingCmdHandler, WaitingCmdHandler
public abstract class CommandHandler extends Object
Abstract base class for handling JSON-based commands in the game architecture.

Provides the foundation for registering and executing command handlers associated with string-based command types. Subclasses are responsible for defining the command types they handle by implementing registerHandlers().

      public CommandHandler(GameModel gameModel, Map<VirtualView,Player> playerMap, MessageDispatcher dispatcher)
      Constructs a new CommandHandler with the specified game model, player map, and dispatcher. Automatically invokes registerHandlers() to populate supported command types.
      Parameters:
      gameModel - the current game model
      playerMap - a mapping between virtual views and players
      dispatcher - the dispatcher responsible for communication between components

  • Method Details

    • handle

      public void handle(VirtualView senderView, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode cmd)
      Handles an incoming command by dispatching it to the appropriate handler based on its type.

      If no handler is registered for the command type, handleUnrecognizedCommand(VirtualView, JsonNode) is called.

      Parameters:
      senderView - the virtual view representing the sender
      cmd - the JSON command object
